# H2a power (generated by analysis/p2_power_h2a.py; dev split only, test right/wrong counts)

One-sided paired DeLong test of AUROC(probe) > AUROC(verbal) at α/6 (first Holm step), 2000 simulated test sets drawn from dev within label. The dev effect is optimistic (layer and C were selected on the same items). 'Half effect': Gaussian noise on the probe score, scaled on dev so the expected probe AUROC is the verbal AUROC plus half the dev gap. Pool ×k: k times the test right and wrong counts.
